item.title: Long Time No See
item.description: Hello again! 👋 It’s been a while, I know I keep promising to update this thing and then I don’t, lets see if that changes anytime soon haha Anyway, quick update as always: I got really into the gym! Lost a bunch of weight and even starting boxing a bunch of times a week! overall pretty excited for whatever’s next, As always, Take care :)
